zoe: quick heads-up  after the kernel-picker change Im seeing extra host CPU on proxy nodes. p99 tokenization tail up and lots of tiny grpc writes. flame snippet in a sec. anyone free to look? :worried:

pat: which pool/stack? paste the top frames and syscall counts. my initial suspicion is flush points causing writev churn.

zoe: us-west1 proxy pool. flame (summary):
```
  46% host::tokenize_serialize
  30% net::grpc::emit_small_writev
  14% parse::frame_split
  10% kernel::fallback_dispatch
```
writev ~8-12 calls per 1KB output during spike.

li: we also saw kvcache miss/eviction blips at the same timestamps. batching window appears to be tighter under load. could be warmup/order interaction with the kernel prefetch.

pat: did you try toggling kernel_prefetch or widening batch.window_ms? those knobs tend to interact.

zoe: brief canary with kernel_prefetch=on, batch.window_ms=3: small req CPU down ~7% but long-seq p99 up ~3.8%. kvcache hit dropped 0.83->0.68, evictions/sec 310->1150. writev counts: small 13->4, long 21->30.

li: classic tradeoff. proposal: run a small matrix: 
- A: prefetch=off, window_ms=3 (baseline)
- B: prefetch=on, window_ms=3
- C: prefetch=on, window_ms=12
- D: prefetch=on, window_ms=12 + microbatch(count=3,max_delay_ms=6)
Synthetic workload: 96% short (8-24 tokens) + 4% long (600-900 tokens). Measure p50/p95/p99 host CPU, tokenize wall_ns, writev/syscalls/request, per-shard kvcache histograms, and E2E latency SLOs.

pat: agree. also check transport coalescing: `transport.write_coalesce=true` in prod but might not be firing if runtime flush calls are too frequent. audit flush callsites in tokenizer/streamer.

perf-bot: canary group C spun up (start 4824678050). /perf run --matrix=C --trace=flame,kvcache,syscalls posted.

infra-bot: canary-c-4824678050 deployed and healthy. logs: https://perf.internal/runs/48246780 (flame + CSVs).

zoe: quick results from C: small req CPU -6.5%, long p99 +2.6%, kvcache hit improved to 0.78, evictions/sec down to ~620. writev counts slightly lower overall. TLDR attached.

li: promising. microbatcher (D) likely to reduce write churn for mixed traffic; be wary of added p50 for tiny bursts. action items:
- pat: run full A/B/C/D matrix and upload CSVs + per-shard kvcache histos.
- li: add kernel-variant serialize microbench and gate kernel-picker on serialize_ns regression.
- zoe: file PERF ticket with hypothesis, attach flames and CSVs, recommend interim flags (prefetch=on, window_ms=12, microbatch count=3,max_delay=6ms) and rollback plan.

zoe: will file PERF-5591 and start the matrix runs. will update when results are in. :thumbsup:
